实际缓存存储目录，由播放器管理，不可修改。: Cache location managed by the player. Read only.
自动模式根据媒体来源决定是否启用缓存。: Auto mode enables caching based on the media source.
保留已读取的数据，以便向后跳转和重复播放。: Keep data already read for seeking backward and replaying.
等待缓存补充后再继续播放，减少断续播放。: Wait for the cache to refill before resuming to reduce interruptions.
启用缓冲暂停时，先积累缓存再开始播放。: Build up the cache before playback when buffer pausing is enabled.
缓冲暂停后，至少缓存多少秒再恢复播放。: Minimum seconds to buffer before resuming after a buffer pause.
开始播放前，等待解复用缓存达到预读目标。: Wait for demuxer cache to reach its readahead target before playing.
按 HTTP、前向、回看顺序分配。0 表示各自独立限额。: Allocate to HTTP, forward and seek caches in order. 0 gives each its own limit.
为已下载的媒体数据保留的内存上限。: Maximum memory reserved for downloaded media data.
网络缓存每个数据块的大小。: Size of each data chunk in the network cache.
单次 HTTP 范围请求读取的数据量。: Amount of data read by one HTTP range request.
分配前向内存预算；启用磁盘缓存后按此比例扩展媒体窗口。0 表示用尽可用预算。: Forward memory budget and media window ratio when disk caching is enabled. 0 uses all available memory.
分配回看内存预算，并确定磁盘回看空间比例。0 表示关闭。: Seek memory budget and disk seek space ratio. 0 disables it.
最多保留多少个可供跳转的缓存区间。: Maximum number of cached ranges available for seeking.
允许回看缓存使用尚未占用的前向预算。: Allow seek cache to use unoccupied forward cache memory.
将较远的数据存入磁盘，扩大预读和回看范围。: Store distant data on disk to extend readahead and backward seeking.
限制磁盘缓存使用的空间。: Limit the space used by disk cache.
选择何时移除磁盘上的缓存文件。: Choose when to remove cached files from disk.
网络播放时希望提前缓存的时长，仍受容量上限约束。: Desired buffering time for network playback, limited by cache capacity.
提前读取并准备待解码数据的时长。: Duration of data read ahead and prepared for decoding.
限制数据包提前读取的时长。0 表示不限。: Limit how far packets are read ahead. 0 is unlimited.
根据下载速度调整网络分段请求大小。: Adjust network range request size based on download speed.
自动决定缓存消耗多少后开始补充，避免频繁读停。: Decide when to refill as the cache is consumed, avoiding frequent pauses.
缓存消耗多少秒后开始补充。启用自动阈值时，0 表示自动。: Refill after this many seconds are consumed. 0 is automatic when the automatic threshold is enabled.
